vocabulary.meaning: a competition to see who or what can move fastest
examples: The village holds a snail race every summer.
The race attracted many curious visitors.

vocabulary.meaning: a person or animal taking part in a competition
examples: Each competitor was placed in the centre of the circle.
The fastest competitor reached the edge first.

vocabulary.meaning: the line that marks the end of a race
examples: The snail slowly crossed the finish line.
Spectators cheered when the first competitor reached the finish line.

vocabulary.meaning: a person who watches an event
examples: Hundreds of spectators watched the unusual competition.
The spectators laughed and took photos.

vocabulary.meaning: a competition that decides the best performer
examples: The annual snail championship has become a local tradition.
She brought her snail to the championship.

vocabulary.meaning: the speed at which someone or something moves
examples: The race continued at a very slow pace.
One snail suddenly increased its pace.

vocabulary.meaning: a person or animal involved in an activity or event
examples: Every participant received a number.
The organisers carefully handled the animal participants.

vocabulary.meaning: a custom or activity passed down over time
examples: The event has become a popular local tradition.
Unusual traditions can attract tourists.

vocabulary.meaning: the person or animal that finishes first or performs best
examples: The winner received a small trophy.
No one expected that snail to be the winner.
The race is a fun community event.
Local businesses help sponsor the event.
